_comment: Priority research topics for the Healthy Aging Digital Intervention Research Platform, stored as PubMed SEARCH QUERIES (NOT identifiers). Harvesting these (src/pubmedharvest.ts harvestTopicBatch) runs the evidence-kind PubMed connector over each query so the empirical, cited content layer for the platform's priority domains — loneliness, social connection, psychosocial & digital interventions, purpose/meaning, and instrument validation in older adults — is generated from REAL papers (a real PMID + abstract quote by construction; new claims are written unverified for the review queue). We never hardcode or invent a PMID/DOI. Edit/extend freely.
